description: The six (H1)-realizability witnesses for the complete admissible-Gram classification at (s, i) = (3, 4): a +-1 table Q in {+-1}^(16 x 12) with Q Q^T = I_4 (x) M, one for each of the two admissible Grams over Gbar = Z_4 and each of the four over Gbar = Z_2 x Z_2. Rows of Q are indexed k = i*I + c with I in 0..3 the superblock and c in Gbar; columns are the 4s = 12 border columns. Each row is a 12-character sign string.

provenance.derived: derived and verified at the source laboratory, 2026-09-01: an exhaustive (H1)-realizability search over Q in {+-1}^(16x12) with two verdict-exact symmetry reductions (column signs; column permutations), reported 6/6 realizable
provenance.what_is_banked: only the six witnesses. Nothing about the search is trusted here: a witness is self-certifying, and certs/12-gram-rigidity/run.py re-checks every one of the 16x16 inner products of Q Q^T against I_4 (x) M in exact integer arithmetic.
provenance.not_banked: the number of solutions Q for each M, which the source search did not compute
